CONSTANS S P F AVG ; VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

A nummus of Constans (AD337-350) minted in Trier between AD 347 and 348 (RIC vol VIII pg 152 no. 195). Flavius Iulius Constans Augustus was the younger brother of Constantine II, and the two ended up eventually going to war, with Constans emerging victorious. He would later himself be killed by his own troops in AD 350. Obverse:- Constans, rosette-diademed, draped and cuirassed, facing right.…
